by_segment: Growing business owner or founder (10-50 staff)

why_not: It's nice to look at, but it's all about letter spacing and logo measurements. I run a growing business and I need to know that a new brand will bring me more customers, and this post never says that.

The slides are nice to look at, but it is the studio talking about its own letters and logo. Nothing shows a business like mine that they rebranded, what it looked like before and after, or what it cost. I might drop a comment for a free look because it costs me nothing, but I would not pay anyone off this carousel.

I'm watching what I spend this year, and this is a design studio talking about letters and measurements with no price anywhere. I'd assume a proper brand job costs more than I can justify for a business my size, so I'd scroll past.
I run a small business on tight money, and this post never says what anything costs. Pretty letters are nice, but I'd still want to know the price before I give up a WhatsApp break to think about it.

We already have a designer and I can make our flyers in Canva myself. Five slides about measuring letters are nice to look at, but I can't see what a brand rebuild would change for a business like mine that is worth paying for.
flip: A real before-and-after case where a business like mine got more enquiries or sales after a rebrand, with the numbers shown.
A clear fixed price with a list of what I get for it, and proof from a business my size that it paid off in more customers.
Real before-and-after work from hotels or clinics like mine, with a clear price range I can see before I speak to anyone.
Named clients in my kind of business, with before and after results and a local office or a phone number I can call and visit.
A clear price range for a brand identity and a few examples of small local businesses like mine they have already done, with a local contact I can call.
Real before-and-after work for businesses like mine, with a named client and a measurable result such as more bookings or enquiries.
A clear starting price, plus two or three real client examples showing what changed for their business.
A plain-English example of a brand they've done for a business like mine, with a clear price and what I'd get in writing.
Seeing a real before and after for a business like mine, such as a hotel or clinic they rebranded, with the results they got from it.
Three named case studies from businesses like mine, with the before and after and the revenue or bookings change, plus a call with the people who would actually do the work.
